context:
Goal: a batch run is not lost to a mutation-harness change that no one ran at CI size.
Problem (rule): #2443 makes lane lint run the mutation job's command when a PR touches hooks/mutate_*.py. Your ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (item 27 a, 2026-10-27) says a lane never runs a whole CI job, so only you can allow this.
Based on (ruling): decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (owner, 2026-10-27, page item 27 a): a lane never runs a whole CI job, and merge --lane-lint runs lint steps only.
Based on (measured): #1597's harness change timed out on every target in batch 68's CI run 42620238014 (670 of 694 results unknown), and that batch run was lost.
Based on (measured): the run costs 11 to 16 min per lane. The share of lanes it hits, about 12%, is a lane estimate, unmeasured.
Departs from: main — lane lint runs lint steps only → adds the mutation job's command for lanes that touch hooks/mutate_*.py.
Meanwhile: #2443 is held. Its lane rewrote that decision with no ruling from you, so the PR keeps that edit only on a.

options.gain: A broken harness is caught before the batch, so no batch run is lost to it.
options.how: Ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job gains one exception: a harness change's own suite is the mutation job. #2443 is released with its decision edit.
options.label: Allow it as a named exception (Recommended)
options.lose: 11 to 16 min more for each lane that touches the harness.

options.how: #2443 drops the lane run and its decision edit; batch CI stays the only check.
options.label: Keep the ruling as it is
options.lose: A broken harness costs a whole batch run, as it did in batch 68.

reply: Routed 13:11 CST Nov 9 to step mutate-harness-change-timed-run (the coordinator), roadmap 2e2d190de. Ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job gains the named exception; #2443 is released with its decision edit.
short: Lane runs the mutation job on a harness change
title: May a lane that changes the mutation harness run the mutation job's command before its batch?
